name: Cathode Ray Tube
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: Cathode Ray Tube was released on August 6, 2021, for purchase in a special bundle only available until the 9th of the month.[1]

It could be purchased as part of a larger bundle costing 19 990 ; the bundle was named "old school" and apart from the paint, also came with 200x Ultra Containers, Hornet and Railgun Mk2, and the Ultra skins for Railgun and Hornet.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
